label_contract.mechanism: MessageText chooses ._classic for ui=az2 and inserts corresponding base aliases; message expressions then expand. This is source behavior, not a read of the running user configuration.
label_contract.compatibility: Preserve internal original MDI identity Library and existing Library.* configuration keys; changing displayed wording is not a persistent-key migration.
label_contract.locale_variants: French source uses Mes torrents/Mes trackers/Mes partages; German Meine Torrents/Mein Tracker/Mein Share; Hebrew provides localized My... strings. Do not freeze all languages to English: the user-requested English preview label is My Torrents. Mnemonic ampersands are UI metadata, not visible literal characters.

primary_entries.label: My Torrents
primary_entries.close_policy: setupSidebarClassic creates library entry with closeable=false
primary_entries.first_slice: Activate existing split-table My Torrents screen from any main page; preserve table/filter/detail state, do not recreate the worker/profile lease.

primary_entries.label: My Tracker
primary_entries.close_policy: registered createEntry(builder,true), reopen by same ID after close
primary_entries.domain: TRHostTorrent hosted/published tracker entries from core.getTrackerHost(); not per-download announce URLs and not the All Trackers screen.
primary_entries.first_slice: Open a distinct clearly offline read-only page, using supplied generated host rows or an honest no-hosted-data-supplied state. Never start tracker hosting as a navigation side effect.

primary_entries.label: My Shares
primary_entries.close_policy: registered createEntry(builder,true), reopen by same ID after close
primary_entries.domain: ShareManager ShareResource objects, with file/directory/directory-contents sharing semantics; not a list of every completed download or payload file.
primary_entries.first_slice: Open distinct clearly offline read-only supplied sharing view or unavailable empty state. No folder scan, drag/drop sharing, torrent creation, publishing or default share-manager initialization.

menu_scope_notes: MainMenuV2 rebuilds View children on menu-show; MenuFactory attaches accelerators through KeyBindings. Native QAction lifetime must make Ctrl+1/2/3 active while the menu is closed, not create shortcuts only while showing the menu.
KeyBindings maps Meta/Cmd to platform primary modifier: Ctrl on Linux, Command on macOS. Localized/platform-specific accelerator overrides are supported; do not interpret source Meta as Linux Super.

All Peers/Detailed List/Device Manager calls are commented out in this classic View list. Console/Statistics/Speed Limits are Tools entries on Linux (View on macOS); Ctrl+4 and Ctrl+5 belong to Console and Statistics, not additional invented My... pages.
Toolbar toggles actual visibility and follows IconBar.enabled with listener removal on disposal. Remote Pairing/Subscriptions are service boundaries, not harmless equivalent local table actions.
mdi_navigation_contract: showEntryByID delegates loadEntryByID(id,true,false,null). Existing entry is activated/reused, not duplicated; absent entries use registered factory/builder and become active.
TabbedMDI main constructor disables destroy-on-deactivate to retain main-view UI state. showEntry hides old and shows new; activating current entry re-shows/notifies rather than cloning it.

Main library is noncloseable. My Tracker and My Shares can close, release view subscriptions and reopen once by stable ID. User-initiated close selects a previous entry; this is navigation, never torrent removal or owner shutdown.

Main TabbedMDI tracks bounded selection history (64) and tabsauto.config open-tab state. This preview need not import/write real tabsauto.config; persistence must remain generated-profile-only until explicitly integrated.

Source keyboard handling includes Esc/Ctrl+F4 close, F6/Ctrl+Tab next tab and File close-tab Ctrl+W. Preserve current Cancel/Escape semantics during an active native operation; do not add an unconditional global Escape handler that bypasses cancellation/lifecycle rules.

bounded_screen_followups.work: Literal My Torrents and navigation actions
bounded_screen_followups.acceptance: View first item My Torrents shows Ctrl+1; menu activation and shortcut return to same existing screen from My Tracker/My Shares. Repeated activation leaves one tab per stable ID and preserves filter/sort/selection.

bounded_screen_followups.work: My Tracker/My Shares distinct close/reopen navigation
bounded_screen_followups.acceptance: Ctrl+2/3 and menu actions open/focus correct page, do not duplicate it; close/reopen works without canceling unrelated transfer/lease. Empty/unavailable state distinguishes no supplied generated rows from a real verified empty user service.

bounded_screen_followups.work: Owned read-only models with public generated snapshots
bounded_screen_followups.acceptance: Tracker columns begin Name, Tracker, Status, Category, Passive, External, Persistent, Seeds, Peers (remaining announce/scrape/completion/byte counters only when genuinely supplied). Share columns follow Name, Type, Category, Tags, Persistent, Date. No invented healthy states, statistics, shares or trackers; source row lifecycle subscriptions are modeled safely before live integration.

bounded_screen_followups.work: Toolbar visibility and lightweight generated Transfers Bar
bounded_screen_followups.acceptance: Toggle actual visible state with synchronized checkmark; auxiliary bar uses actual owned displayed telemetry or explicit offline/unknown values. No peer/service/network startup.

bounded_screen_followups.work: Client Stats or other service-backed pages
bounded_screen_followups.acceptance: ClientStatsView aggregates peer-client observations and persists ClientStats.dat; qualify an owned supplied snapshot before claiming client statistics. Keep pairing, subscriptions and plugin views explicitly unavailable until their service contracts exist. This audit does not authorize those services.

acceptance_for_implementers: Exercise Ctrl+1/2/3 from table, filter editor, General/Files and alternate main pages with menu closed; visible active page and focus match the action once.

Record main-page IDs separately from selected-torrent hash/generation. Pending detail completion may safely update its retained My Torrents page only; it cannot replace another active page or revive a closed auxiliary page.
Changing navigation does not acquire another profile lease, rebuild the session worker, join peers, read the original profile or mutate inventory/cache/payloads.
Repeated open/focus/close/reopen releases page-owned connections/subscriptions and avoids duplicate actions; unavailable destructive/share/host buttons never dispatch.
Automated model/action/keyboard tests and a source-bound manual compositor check remain future actual evidence. No app/build/test/process/network action was performed for this audit.
